source.binary: libUnreal.so loaded by the live TFT PBE process

methodology.mapping: offset-zero libUnreal.so mapping plus storage VMAs recovered from the same SHA-256 binary
methodology.read: four bytes per known FAutoConsoleVariableRef storage through root /proc/PID/mem

interpretation.direct_write: The candidate remains 1 after OpenGL capability initialization; it is not silently forced back to zero.
interpretation.mapping_flags: MapBuffer, buffer discard, unsynchronized mapping, and persistent-mapping capability are already enabled by platform initialization and are not candidate opportunities.
interpretation.staging: UseStagingBuffer is zero, so the enabled persistent-staging capability is not an active staging path.
interpretation.boundary: Promotion still requires matched late-PvP A/B and render-correctness checks.
